_target: NVIDIA RTX 4060 8GiB GDDR6 — CUDA backend only — code-completion / tool-use / MCP workloads
_context_strategy: KV quantization is the primary lever for context maximization on 8GiB VRAM. turbo4/turbo4 enables 32K ctx; q8_0/q8_0 caps at 16K; q4_0/q4_0 matches turbo4 at 32K but lower quality. MTP model (Q6_K, 7.1GiB) requires NGL≤28 to leave room for KV cache.

kv_types._note: ~4-bit symmetric — maximizes context window; primary target for code-completion evals
8-bit standard — quality baseline; limits ctx to ~16K on 8GiB
4-bit K + turbo4 V — asymmetric; K is access-critical, V can be compressed harder
4-bit standard symmetric — maximum context, minimum KV quality floor

bench_params._prompts_note: 512 and 1024 included — CUDA has no KV_max OOB restriction (ROCm-only issue). 16384 validates large-context code-completion pipeline.
bench_params._n_gen_note: 256 tokens simulates a typical code-completion response (function body, short block). Keeps each run bounded.
bench_params._kv_offload_note: -nkvo 0 = no_kv_offload=false = KV cache stays on VRAM (dGPU). Required for context-maximization testing.

cuda._note: RTX 4060 8GiB — single dGPU, all layers offloaded where VRAM allows

models.name: Tesslate_OmniCoder-9B-Q4_K_M
models._model_note: 5.6GiB Q4_K_M — fits fully on 8GiB with KV headroom for 32K ctx at turbo4/turbo4. Code-completion specialist.
models._vram_estimate: Model ~6.1GiB on VRAM + 10% CUDA overhead = ~6.7GiB; ~1.4GiB free for KV cache

models.name: Qwen3.5-9B-UD-Q4_K_XL
models._model_note: 5.8GiB Q4_K_XL — Unsloth imatrix quant; slightly higher quality than Q4_K_M. Tool-use and MCP server tasks.
models._vram_estimate: Model ~6.3GiB + overhead; ~1.2GiB free for KV. turbo4/turbo4 fits 32K; q8_0 limited to 16K.

models.name: Qwopus3.5-9B-Coder-MTP-Q6_K
models._model_note: 7.1GiB Q6_K MTP model — Multi-Token Prediction head; cannot fully offload on 8GiB. NGL≤28 required to leave KV cache room. Tests MTP throughput on code-completion.
models._vram_estimate: NGL=28: ~6.8GiB weights on GPU; ~300 MiB free — enough for turbo4/turbo4 at 8K-16K ctx. q8_0 may OOM at 16K.
models._mtp_note: MTP (speculative multi-token) head is loaded alongside main model; factor into VRAM budget.
models._mtp_flags_note: --mtp-n-max 0,2 benchmarks baseline (0) vs 2-token speculative decoding. -ctkd/-ctvd q4_0 keeps draft KV cache small to fit within the already-tight VRAM budget at NGL=28.

logging._log_note: Log filenames are tagged CUDA-ONLY. Separate subdir isolates CUDA runs from multi-backend logs.

watchdog._note: 1800s (30 min) per run; MTP model at large ctx may be slow — increase if needed
